cases.report_quote: Any reader can send `{"capability":"document.preview","tenant":"<other tenant>","key":"guide"}` and get another tenant's document body. `document.read` blocks this with `require_tenant`.
cases.reason: Report demonstrates an enabled own reader session, caller-controlled foreign selector and preview dispatch to the global unfiltered Store; full adapter/policy/dispatch chain independently checked.

cases.report_quote: `demo-reader` has the `export` scope, so it can run `account.archive` and export its whole tenant. The dedicated `account.export` route correctly refuses it. The README says owners alone may export.
cases.reason: Report distinguishes export scope from owner role and traces archive metadata dropped by prepare to complete-row export; reader needs neither owner role nor foreign credentials.
Report distinguishes the dedicated read tenant check from the vulnerable capability path.

cases.report_quote: `prepare()` takes `tenant` from the caller's arguments. It never compares it with `permit.tenant`, and nothing downstream does either. `dispatch()` only checks the permit's operation name, and `Store` applies no policy, as the README says.
cases.reason: Read with its complete finding, report follows caller tenant selection through scope permit, dispatch and complete document storage; it identifies the missing selected-versus-permit tenant check.

cases.report_quote: Any caller with the `export` scope can send `{"capability":"account.archive","tenant":"<other tenant>"}` and get that tenant's full account rows. `account.export` pins the tenant to `request.identity.tenant`.
cases.reason: Read with its complete finding, report follows owner-only metadata, omitted policy argument, export permit and full account-row sink.
Report makes a concrete assessment of direct read scope/tenant enforcement and compares the alternative path.
Report makes a concrete assessment of direct export owner/scope policy and own-tenant selection.
Purge audit/tenant observations do not trace its complete destructive authorization path.
Partial text/container/error observations do not assess the full combination of capability-name allowlisting, selector validation and unknown-resource errors.

additional_supported_gaps: Purge has no audit event; denials are not audited; events omit the selected tenant/target and live only in a bounded in-memory deque.
verdict.notes: Static source-evidence grading only. Both required authorization findings are independently supported. Missing named guard/coverage assessments are completeness omissions, not factual errors. Exact quotes validate existence, not runtime proof. Code-only observations use supplied local code and contracts; no ungrounded external authority claim is made. Corrected grading: materiality and full-paragraph scope applied; original output retained.
unsupported_gap_claims: events hold only the subject, action and count, not the target tenant. — The missing-target finding is supported, but the definite exhaustive inventory omits the actual request_id field.
